scope.quantity: Actual dense inversion-coordinate derivative P^T g for m(theta)=m_initial+P*(theta-m_initial).

scope.accepted_claim: AD and Hybrid agree for this declared constrained-coordinate derivative at the unchanged 1e-8 tolerance.
scope.full_physical_status: Original full-physical threshold failed; full physical g remains auxiliary diagnostic evidence. Discrepancy cause unresolved.
scope.physical_quality_limit: Observed receiver trace screen passed for this configuration and time interval; no general stability proof, continuum grid-convergence or recovered-model claim.
scope.density_limit: True and initial density are the same constant; rho derivatives are objective sensitivities.

publication_rule: Explicit constrained-scope opt-in only. Keep summary.passed=false, disclose the failed full-physical gate in figure titles/reports, and verify these artifact hashes before plotting.
